_: The physical world when a scheme is off. mesh_bindings is closed-world: every built node or dressing rule that exists because of a scheme is named here. becomes is a design decision, not a viewer instruction.
_authored: Authored data, not generated. The 'estate-review package 4' this file once named as its generator does not exist in the tree; the false generated_by was removed on 17 September 2026. A scheme's felled_stems is the one machine-checkable number here: the scheme names its felling predicate and fcm.checks.contract.scheme_felling.felled_stem_findings (wired into R38) derives the count from that predicate and refuses any difference.

survey.albedo: existing terrain albedo before scheme treatment
survey.trees: Felled survey stems are not reinstated: a tree felled for works remains a factual loss in both worlds, not a reversible rendering option.

becomes.ground: existing courtyard fabric remains; the pool asset's own paving and plant go

Sch_CourtyardPool.note: The pool is a proposal inserted into standing courtyard fabric. No terrain grading is baked for it.

Sch_StaffVillage.label: Staff village, Meadows North, 80 beds

becomes.ground: survey terrain and existing albedo; no terrain grading is baked for the village

Sch_StaffVillage.note: Three source tree indices are removed by the village footprint. They are not resurrected by a scheme toggle. | felled_stems 3 is staff-village-source.json's square.trees_felled_indices, the index list the build's tree stage reads; the predicate is named here and derived by R38, not hand-counted.

Sch_Gatehouses.label: Gatehouses and lodge extensions, staff

becomes.ground: the already-survey terrain under all five gatehouse placements; no separate serving ground node is emitted

Sch_Gatehouses.note: Measured build inventory has no gatehouse hardstanding, kerb, planting or graded-terrain node to bind. Binding shared estate terrain would wrongly hide existing fabric.

Sch_RiverClub.label: River Club Building, Thames Frontage

becomes.ground: survey terrain and existing albedo in the formal River Club corridor; existing Long Water water remains

Sch_RiverClub.note: The 116.75 m formal corridor grade, canal copings, swimming works and Club precinct are scheme works. The eighteenth-century canal is existing fabric. | water-long-water.precinct.metal_dark retired with the mouth sluice on 15 September 2026: with only the head third treated the sluice has nothing to isolate, so the build emits no metal_dark bundle to bind. | felled_stems 9 is the count fcm.model.river_club.precinct.fells returns for the 2,512-stem survey array (indices 94, 102, 110, 154, 155, 221, 257, 1124, 1933; deck 5, weir 1, canal copings 4, allee 2, garden 0, with overlaps). The file carried 8 from generation 10 until 17 September 2026: it was a hand count, never compared to the predicate, and the precinct's felling has moved since. R38 derives the number now.

Sch_SpaGarden.label: Spa Garden

becomes.ground: survey terrain and existing albedo under the spa-garden work

Sch_SpaGarden.note: The Spa Garden surface is a scheme proposal over the shared core grade; its off-state requires a local survey overlay rather than hiding the estate-wide core. | The survey species nodes are the species the planting actually fells (broadleaf and cedar): tests/test_switches.py derives them from fcm.model.planting.spa and refuses any hand-listed species - the retired poplar and veteran entries - that the planting does not carry. | prop.spa-garden is built again on 15 September 2026 as physical fabric inside the spa precinct asset (spa-precinct-garden): the switch owns the scheme ground, the planting and the garden fabric node. | The ground region is the precinct's three garden zones (entrance side, spa pool side, leisure garden face) carried as one rotated rectangle at the precinct's own rotation -18.9787 deg; the reader fcm/model/scheme_ground.py supports only the rotated-rectangle kind, so the three-zone L is bounded, not traced. | felled_stems 20 is the count fcm.model.planting.spa measures for the precinct footprint (indices 14, 37, 103, 133, 159, 211, 295, 343, 479, 582, 652, 795, 841, 1035, 1195, 1268, 1284, 1805, 2150, 2255; broadleaf and cedar). Stem 1805 was added on 16 Sep 2026: it stood on the tennis court's 0.05 m hardstanding, which the solid and crown tests never met, so the planting now also fells a stem standing on a near-horizontal spa surface.
